title: Simplicial subsets of finite simplicial sets are finite
statement: Let $X$ be a simplicial set in a fixed universe, with finitely many nondegenerate simplices [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set]. Let $A\subseteq X$ be any simplicial subset, meaning subsets $A_n\subseteq X_n$ stable under all face and degeneracy maps, with the induced simplicial operators. Then $A$ has finitely many nondegenerate simplices. The empty subset and $A=X$ are allowed.
